prompt: Add a command that removes stale temp files older than N days.
expected_output: A new Remove-/Clear- function under Public/ deletes temp files older than N days, gated behind [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess)] and a real $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess call, using Write-Verbose/Write-Output instead of Write-Host; nothing new lands at the repository root.

expectations.text: A new function uses an approved verb such as Remove- or Clear-
No function writes output with Write-Host
The function calls $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess before deleting anything
Nothing new lands at the repository root
